name: mcp-statement-of-account
description: Per-client statements of account, aging buckets and dunning letters from your own books.

license_key.title: License key
license_key.description: Optional Pro license key (format MCPL1.xxx.yyy). Leave blank to use the free tier.

tools.name: statement_build
tools.description: Build one client's statement of account for a period: opening balance, invoices issued, payments received, credit notes, deposits applied and closing balance, in minor units and formatted.

tools.name: statement_aging
tools.description: Break what is owed into 0-30, 31-60, 61-90 and over 90 days past the invoice due date as at a chosen date, for one client or for every client, per currency. Free and unlimited.

tools.name: statement_text
tools.description: Turn one client's statement into a plain-text ledger with every movement in date order, the opening and closing balances and a sign-off, ready to paste into an email.

tools.name: statement_pdf
tools.description: Call this tool to write one client's A4 statement of account and return the file path. Titled STATEMENT OF ACCOUNT, every movement in date order, closing with the balance outstanding. Pro.

tools.name: dunning_text
tools.description: Write a payment chaser for one client at level 1 friendly, 2 firm or 3 final demand, listing every overdue invoice with its age and total, plus your bank details when the profile has them. Level 3 is Pro.

tools.name: statements_report
tools.description: Show what is outstanding across every client, totalled per currency and aged, with the oldest overdue invoice and the clients carrying it. Pro.

tools.name: license_status
tools.description: Show whether this server runs in free or Pro mode and where to upgrade.

tools.name: license_activate
tools.description: Activate a Pro license key (format MCPL1.xxx.yyy). Verified offline and saved locally.
